title: Fix Input Design Panning and Background Deselect in Algorithms
description: Fix Input Design Panning and Background Deselect in Algorithms
summary: Fixed two issues in algorithm input designs: (1) Enabled panning by changing panEnabled false to true in PIECES_SELECTION_INPUT window config. (2) Added drag detection (didPanDragRef) to distinguish click-to-deselect from drag-to-pan in ComposeDiagram, preventing accidental deselection after panning while still allowing background click deselection.
